title: Child care, Indigenous logos and community agreements
subtitle: Elora green space lighting, Fergus Grand Theatre grant, arts loan, well land purchase, and planning delegation changes.
overview: Council backed a County-led approach to child care in Belwood, with the Township in a supporting role, and agreed to write to County Council encouraging it to look into building child care facilities {{vote:m11}}. Decisions on future outdoor recreation in Belwood wait for the Parks and Recreation Plan.

Council directed staff to reinstall banners at the Jefferson Elora Community Centre arena, leaving out banners with Indigenous-themed logos or names, until a policy is in place. A working group under the DEI Advisory Committee will continue developing that policy {{vote:m10}}.

Council approved several agreements: a Fergus Tennis Club amendment with new rental and hydro charges {{vote:m2}}, a Highland Rugby Club lease extension {{vote:m3}}, and donated seasonal lighting for the Elora green space {{vote:m9}}. It also approved an interest-free loan for the Elora Centre for the Arts {{vote:m13}}, a grant application for Fergus Grand Theatre renovations {{vote:m5}}, and a housing needs assessment tied to federal funding {{vote:m8}}.
After closed session, Council approved buying land at 7715 Sideroad 15, Fergus, for a future municipal supply well {{vote:m16}}.

decisions.detail: Council supported a County-led, collaborative approach to child care with the Township supporting, deferred Belwood outdoor recreation decisions to the Parks and Recreation Plan, and will write to the County encouraging child care facilities.

Council directed staff to reinstall arena banners at the Jefferson Elora Community Centre excluding Indigenous-themed ones until a policy is adopted, and to continue the working group's policy work with public updates on Connect CW.
Council authorized an Agreement of Purchase and Sale for a portion of 7715 Sideroad 15, Fergus, for a future municipal supply well facility at $55,500.
Council authorized a grant application for upstairs renovations at the Fergus Grand Theatre, with up to $8,000 from General Capital Reserves if successful.
Council approved the renewed Municipal Funding Agreement and directed staff to hire an external consultant for the required Housing Needs Assessment.
Council approved a donation agreement for seasonal lighting and delegated authority to the Managing Director of Community Services to vary design, cost and operating times annually.

decisions.item: Elora Centre for the Arts loan
decisions.detail: Council authorized a new interest-free loan agreement with the Elora Centre for the Arts, with the by-law passed in a separate vote.
Council gave three readings to a by-law replacing Schedule A of the delegation by-law 2023-78.
